t: 尾部议会投票决定审判查理一世。
te: The Rump Parliament votes to put Charles I on trial.
dz: 英国内战：尾部议会投票决定审判查理一世。
de: English Civil War: The Rump Parliament votes to put Charles I on trial.

t: 第二次奥尔蒙德和平在"三国之战"中建立了爱尔兰王室主义者和邦联之间的联盟. 联盟随后在克伦威尔…
te: The Second Ormonde Peace creates an alliance between the Irish Royalists and Confederates during the War of the Three K…
dz: 第二次奥尔蒙德和平在"三国之战"中建立了爱尔兰王室主义者和邦联之间的联盟. 联盟随后在克伦威尔征服爱尔兰期间被决定性地击败.
de: The Second Ormonde Peace creates an alliance between the Irish Royalists and Confederates during the War of the Three Kingdoms. The coalition was then decisively defeated during the Cromwellian conquest of Ireland.

t: 审判查理一世的高等法院开始诉讼程序.
te: The High Court of Justice for the trial of Charles I begins its proceedings.
dz: 审判查理一世的高等法院开始诉讼程序.
de: The High Court of Justice for the trial of Charles I begins its proceedings.

t: 英国的查理一世在伦敦怀特霍尔被处决.
te: Charles I of England is executed in Whitehall, London.
dz: 英国的查理一世在伦敦怀特霍尔被处决.
de: Charles I of England is executed in Whitehall, London.

t: 第二次瓜拉拉佩斯战役的进行,有效地结束了荷兰在巴西的殖民努力.
te: The Second Battle of Guararapes takes place, effectively ending Dutch colonization efforts in Brazil.
dz: 第二次瓜拉拉佩斯战役的进行,有效地结束了荷兰在巴西的殖民努力.
de: The Second Battle of Guararapes takes place, effectively ending Dutch colonization efforts in Brazil.

t: 弗朗德尔人和法国政府签署"鲁伊和平".
te: The Frondeurs and the French government sign the Peace of Rueil.
dz: 弗朗德尔人和法国政府签署"鲁伊和平".
de: The Frondeurs and the French government sign the Peace of Rueil.

t: 英格兰下议院通过法案废除上议院,宣布其"对英格兰人民无用而危险".
te: The House of Commons of England passes an act abolishing the House of Lords, declaring it "useless and dangerous to the…
dz: 英格兰下议院通过法案废除上议院,宣布其"对英格兰人民无用而危险".
de: The House of Commons of England passes an act abolishing the House of Lords, declaring it "useless and dangerous to the people of England".

t: 宣布英格兰为联邦的议会法案由长会通过. 未来11年,英格兰将成为一个共和国.
te: An Act of Parliament declaring England a Commonwealth is passed by the Long Parliament. England would be a republic for…
dz: 宣布英格兰为联邦的议会法案由长会通过. 未来11年,英格兰将成为一个共和国.
de: An Act of Parliament declaring England a Commonwealth is passed by the Long Parliament. England would be a republic for the next eleven years.

t: 由阿古斯丁·苏穆鲁伊反抗西班牙殖民当局所领导的北萨马尔的菲律宾人.
te: Filipinos in Northern Samar led by Agustin Sumuroy revolt against Spanish colonial authorities.
dz: 苏穆鲁伊革命的起步:由阿古斯丁·苏穆鲁伊反抗西班牙殖民当局所领导的北萨马尔的菲律宾人.
de: Start of the Sumuroy Revolt: Filipinos in Northern Samar led by Agustin Sumuroy revolt against Spanish colonial authorities.

t: 意大利城市卡斯特罗被教宗英诺森特十世的势力所完全摧毁,结束了卡斯特罗之战.
te: The Italian city of Castro is completely destroyed by the forces of Pope Innocent X, ending the Wars of Castro.
dz: 意大利城市卡斯特罗被教宗英诺森特十世的势力所完全摧毁,结束了卡斯特罗之战.
de: The Italian city of Castro is completely destroyed by the forces of Pope Innocent X, ending the Wars of Castro.

t: 奥利弗·克伦威尔的议会派军队攻克了该镇并执行其驻防地.
te: Oliver Cromwell's Parliamentarian troops take the town and execute its garrison.
dz: 对德罗热达的围攻结束:奥利弗·克伦威尔的议会派军队攻克了该镇并执行其驻防地.
de: Siege of Drogheda ends: Oliver Cromwell's Parliamentarian troops take the town and execute its garrison.

t: 克伦威尔的"新模范军"解雇了韦克斯福德,杀死了超过2000名爱尔兰邦联军队和1500名平民.
te: Cromwell's New Model Army sacks Wexford, killing over 2,000 Irish Confederate troops and 1,500 civilians.
dz: 克伦威尔的"新模范军"解雇了韦克斯福德,杀死了超过2000名爱尔兰邦联军队和1500名平民.
de: Cromwell's New Model Army sacks Wexford, killing over 2,000 Irish Confederate troops and 1,500 civilians.

t: 爱尔兰新罗斯镇向奥利弗·克伦威尔投降.
te: New Ross town in Ireland surrenders to Oliver Cromwell.
dz: 爱尔兰新罗斯镇向奥利弗·克伦威尔投降.
de: New Ross town in Ireland surrenders to Oliver Cromwell.

t: 拉厄镇(瑞典语:Brahestad)由年轻伯爵佩尔·布拉厄所建立.
te: The town of Raahe (Swedish: Brahestad) is founded by Count Per Brahe the Younger.
dz: 拉厄镇(瑞典语:Brahestad)由年轻伯爵佩尔·布拉厄所建立.
de: The town of Raahe (Swedish: Brahestad) is founded by Count Per Brahe the Younger.
